content:
I've just finished updating Functional Programming in Lean to account for all of the changes made in Lean since the last update. It's now tested against the latest release: Lean 4.18.

Thank you all for your careful reading and issue reports.

It'll be getting more attention in the coming weeks as I port it from mdbook to Verso.

Functional Programming in Lean has now been ported to Verso. The text is substantially similar, with only minor corrections since the last release, but it will soon be updated to the latest Lean release as well.

However, it now has hovers all over the place! The experience of reading it should be different, so please let me know if there's any regressions in your experience as a reader from the old version.
